name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state RY(2.505) on qubit 0 followed by CX(0,1), compute the reduced density matrix of qubit 0 via partial trace, and print its von Neumann entanglement entropy (base 2). Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
